messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool p-dedicated-westeu-1 queue depth > 95% (50s) — autoscaler failing to add nodes. Link: https://internal.ops/alerts/4398765432

jessica (oncall): taking this — I'll gather context. paging sdr oncall if needed.

mike (infra): seeing scale-up requests hitting our quota guard. autoscaler logs show 429s from cloud provider and some 500s from driver health API.

sarah (runtime): also seeing a spike in Xid errors on several nodes. tail from driver on node-17:```
[2026-03-15T12:10:01Z] ERROR nv_driver: CUDA Xid 31 on GPU0 -> out of memory while servicing stream 0x7f8
[2026-03-15T12:10:03Z] WARN runtime: kvcache eviction flood, marking node unhealthy
```

jessica (oncall): ok — two things: 1) autoscaler can't provision more nodes due to cloud rate limits 2) some nodes are flapping/down due to driver OOM/Xid, reducing effective capacity. clear customer impact?

emily (support): posting to customers impacted channel: a few requests from large-embeddings jobs are seeing 503s and high latency. early list: acme-analytics, insightai. tickets being opened.

mike (infra): autoscaler backlog shows repeated retries; provider returned "quotaExceeded" on 3 attempts. I'll open a quota increase request but that's not immediate.

infra-bot: scale attempt 2026-03-15T12:11:05Z failed: provider=aws-ec2, error=Throttling: Rate exceeded

jessica (oncall): mitigation plan now: A) drain and restart problem nodes to clear driver state B) redirect new inference traffic to fallback pool (p-hosted-eu2) C) throttle large-batch jobs at ingress (temporary) D) manual node boot if autoscaler still blocked. Sarah, can you identify which nodes to reboot?

sarah (runtime): initial node list: node-17, node-19, node-23 show repeated Xid 31 and oom logs. I'll remote-restart the nvidia driver and watch for Xid recurrence. command I will run: ```ssh node-17 'sudo systemctl restart nvidia-driver && journalctl -u nv_driver -n 200 --no-pager'```

mike (infra): I'll enable the fallback routing rule now: set route weight 80/20 p-dedicated-westeu-1 -> p-hosted-eu2 and apply prefix-based throttles for embedding endpoints. Applying:```yaml
- route: /v1/embeddings/*
  max_concurrency: 6
```

jessica (oncall): emily, tell support to communicate mitigation and ETA. Raj, pls sit on customer comms.

emily (support): posted to #customers-incident-updates: "We're experiencing degraded inference performance in EU region; routing to alternate pool and performing live mitigations. ETA 30-45m."

raj (ops-lead): oncall pager escalation: if queue doesn't shrink to <60% in 10m escalate to SRE lead.

sarah (runtime): restart executed on node-17, node-19. node-23 is unresponsive — kernel-level OOMs observed. Initiating safe reboot. Logs showed repeated: ```nv_driver: GPU0 reset failed (Xid 31) -> marking device NACK```

mike (infra): autoscaler still hitting rate limits; doing manual warm boot of two spare nodes to compensate. manual create instance i-0abc... started.

jessica (oncall): traffic routing in place. monitoring queue depth and 503 rate.

(2m later)

sarah (runtime): node-17 stabilized post-restart, no new Xid in 3m. node-19 recovered. node-23 reboot completed but nv_driver backtrace on boot suggests driver v535.95 may be the trigger. Collecting core dumps.

mike (infra): manual nodes are up and registered to pool. effective GPU count +2, queue depth dropping from 96% -> 62% in last 4m.

emily (support): customers confirming fewer errors; acme-analytics: "latency back to normal for most calls". keeping them updated.

jessica (oncall): good. keep fallback in place until autoscaler is healthy for 30m. next: identify root cause chain: long-running large batch embedding requests + driver instability + provider rate-limited scale-up. Sarah/Mike to collect artifacts.

sarah (runtime): saving core dumps and driver logs to /tmp/incident-4398765432/ and uploading to internal storage. noted a pattern: memory fragmentation followed by huge allocation from a single worker job. will link eval prompt and user id.

mike (infra): raising PR to increase autoscaler backoff window and to add exponential retry jitter to avoid provider throttles. Also adding a short-term override: allow manual capacity boost when queue > 90% and provider returns throttling errors.

jessica (oncall): oncall timeline: declared incident, mitigated via fallback routing and manual nodes. customer impact: partial degradation for 17m, highest error rate 12:10-12:27 UTC, major customers affected (ACME/InsightAI). severity P1 -> downgraded to P2 as of 12:28 UTC.

raj (ops-lead): will open an incident ticket and own postmortem. Initial action items: 1) harden autoscaler retry logic 2) add driver watchdog to auto-reboot before repeated Xid flood 3) limit per-request token/batch size at ingress 4) identify long-running customers and apply soft quotas.

emily (support): created INC-2026-4398 and assigned to raj; ticket includes customer impact notes and comms timeline.

jessica (oncall): final checks: queue stable at 44%, 503 rate ~0.2% now. leaving fallback routing at 20% for 30m then revert if stable. anyone object?

sarah (runtime): thumbs up. I will follow up with driver team on repro and coordinate a canary driver rollback if we confirm v535.95 correlation.

mike (infra): will monitor autoscaler and cloud provider quota progress; if further throttles occur we'll automate manual warm boots.

emily (support): customers updated that services restored and postmortem promised.

jessica (oncall): closing incident channel in 45m once everything stable. Postmortem owner: raj. Action owners assigned. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
